subject: Telemetry AI security: telemetry logs demo & evidence timeline
messages:
From: Gabe Ramos <gabe.ramos@telemetry.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@telemetry.ai
Date: 2026-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Telemetry logs + security intake — demo request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Our security team is running a short intake for vendors that process telemetry and event logs. We'd like a short technical demo focused on:
- event capture architecture (SDK -> ingest)
- retention and deletion controls for raw event logs
- who can access PII within logs, and how access is audited
- sample log formats and redaction approaches

Could your team run a 45-min session next week (PST) and bring: an architecture diagram, a short sample of anonymized logs, and any retention policy docs? I attached our compliance questionnaire (telemetry_compliance_questions_v2.pdf) so you can see the specific items we'll ask about.

Best,
Gabe
Gabe Ramos
Senior Security Engineer, Telemetry AI
G: 415-555-0192
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Gabe Ramos <gabe.ramos@telemetry.ai>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry logs + security intake — demo request

Hi Gabe — great to hear from you and thanks for sending the questionnaire. We're available for a focused session; suggested slots:
- Tue 2026-10-06 09:00–09:45 PT
- Wed 2026-10-07 11:00–11:45 PT
- Thu 2026-10-08 14:00–14:45 PT

Agenda we propose (45m):
1) 10m — quick intros + scope confirmation
2) 20m — architecture walk (SDK, ingest, processing, storage) with diagram
3) 10m — sample logs & redaction/PII controls
4) 5m — artifact next steps and timeline

For artifacts, we'll prepare: anonymized sample logs (redwood_sample_logs.json), an architecture diagram (PDF), and our retention table. Irene will own the artifacts; David will prepare the S3 sample link and a short runbook for log access auditing.

If one of those slots works, I'll send a calendar invite and a temporary Drive folder with the preparatory materials. Also: is there a specific CAIQ/SIG section you want us to prioritize?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance Program Lead, Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-30T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry logs + security intake — artifact owners and checklist

Thanks — assigning owners and timelines. Quick task list (I uploaded a stub artifact_owner_matrix.csv):
- Architecture diagram (Irene) — draft by 2026-10-04
- Sample logs (David) — anonymized, 3 sample sessions, by 2026-10-05; include redaction notes
- Retention & deletion table (Hannah) — export of retention windows for raw/processed, by 2026-10-05
- Audit trails & role mappings (David) — list of who can access raw logs + example audit record, by 2026-10-05

Also note: Telemetry asked specifically about: log-level PII fields, retention-by-customer policy, and access review cadence. We should prepare bullet answers for those sections of the questionnaire so Gabe can triage.

Attachment: artifact_owner_matrix.csv (owners + due dates).

Irene
From: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-30T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry logs + security intake — sample logs location

All — I uploaded three anonymized session samples to a temporary bucket and added a short README. Link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-telemetry-demos/sample-logs (expiry 10/12).
Files: redwood_sample_logs.json (3 small event traces), redaction_notes.md

Quick notes:
- We redacted ip_address and user_email at ingestion using deterministic hashing; request-level PII is redacted via pipeline rule set PII-01; see redaction_notes.md for regexes.
- Raw events are retained 90 days; aggregated indices are retained 2 years. Deletion is handled via lifecycle policy and audit job (job id: AUD-2026-09-30-01).

I'll attach the README and sample JSON to the prep folder once Hannah confirms the meeting time.

-David
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Gabe Ramos <gabe.ramos@telemetry.ai>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-01T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry logs + security intake — demo invite and prep folder

Hi Gabe — thanks for the quick coordination. Confirming Wed 2026-10-07 11:00–11:45 PT for the demo. Calendar invite sent (Zoom link in calendar).

Prep folder (shared): https://redwood.app/drive/TelemetryAI/onboarding-folder
Preliminary materials uploaded: architecture_diagram.pdf, redwood_sample_logs.json, redaction_notes.md, artifact_owner_matrix.csv

Please review the questionnaire sections 4 (data retention), 7 (access control) and 9 (logging/audit) ahead of time; we'll call out where answers are in the Drive docs during the session. If Telemetry needs exported audit records or a scoped SOC2 control mapping before the call, flag that and we'll prioritize.

Agenda will be the same as proposed. Looking forward — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance Program Lead
Redwood Inference
